snippet.title: Bigfoot Life - 30 Second Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
You’re not hunting Bigfoot. YOU ARE BIGFOOT! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108130/Bigfoot_Life/

Be the legend and live your best Bigfoot Life!

Indie game developer and publisher Planet 47 Games is proud to announce their game, Bigfoot Life, officially releases today on steam. This is your chance to step into the life of the world’s most mysterious forest legend, Bigfoot (also known as Sasquatch) and experience the wilderness like never before.

Official Trailer:
https://youtu.be/0t4Z_rBCq24
